address: Level 37, Menara Ilham, 8 Jalan Binjai, Kuala Lumpur, 50450, Malaysia
bio: The open kitchen clad in stone and wood exudes a luxurious vibe and boasts lovely city views through panoramic windows. On the food side, the Japanese head chef offers a single tasting menu of over 15 courses that showcase his creativity and solid skills with a nod to tradition. Ingredients are sourced locally whenever possible. Try his abalone with soba noodles made from scratch, delivering soft, but bouncy texture....
